pages.text: A strong wind blew all night. In the morning, leaves covered the yard. Grandma brought out two brooms.
"I'll sweep the whole yard clean." "Let's do it together." "No, I'll do it all."
Yuki swept from this side. Leaves gathered with a rustle.
A gust blew. Leaves covered the cleared patch again. "Oh? I just swept there!"
Yuki swept faster. Sweat dotted their forehead. "I'll finish soon."
Their palms burned. Yuki dropped the broom and plopped down in the yard.
Only half the yard was clean. The other half was unchanged. "They aren't getting fewer at all."
Grandma stood with her broom at the far end. She walked toward Yuki, pushing leaves ahead.
Yuki stood and took the broom again. Facing each other, they swept. Leaves gathered in the middle.
A mountain of leaves filled the yard's center. All around was spotless. Momo jumped into the pile with a whoosh.
